thread:
emma: Quick idea 1: should per-route saved views be able to pin a per-model breakdown column? Right now saveviews only capture route filters and drop any model pins. Thinking of a toggle `pin_model_breakdown: true` in the savedview payload that instructs the console to render per-model metrics in the route lane. Thoughts?
sam: Yes please. Infra asked for this for rollout audits.
maria: UX Q: if we pin, do we also persist expanded/collapsed state for each model row? Might be noisy. Maybe store expansion separately from the pinned list.
liam: Backend note: POST /api/views currently accepts scope:route + filters. Adding a boolean flag should be backward-compatible if default=false.
noah: Also need to ensure cost preview/telemetry reflects the saved view sampling. Propose adding `telemetry_sample_rate` to the view payload.
emma: Sketch of minimal v2 payload:
```json
{
  \"version\":\"2\",
  \"name\":\"Checkout - pins + sample\",
  \"scope\":{\"type\":\"route\",\"id\":\"route-prod-checkout\"},
  \"filters\":[{\"field\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"success\"}],
  \"pin_model_breakdown\":true,
  \"pinned_models\":[\"mid-7a9c\",\"mid-11b2\"],
  \"telemetry_sample_rate\":0.1
}
```
maria: Couple questions: (1) pinned_models should be stable ids, not mutable slugs. (2) If a pinned model is removed from route or deleted, do we show placeholder or drop it?
sam: Use immutable ids. Show a greyed placeholder row "pinned (missing)" with last-seen metadata and keep the telemetry mapping to the id so historical comparisons still work.
ops-bot: Reminder: canary deploy window tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Adding `version` will require a DB migration and a short compatibility shim.
liam: Migration plan (outline): add `view_version` int column default=1. Write path accepts version and stores 2 when provided. Read path renders pins only when view_version>=2. Rolling deploy: accept v2 writes while older readers ignore pins until migration done.
noah: Also server sanitize pinned_models length to max 12 to prevent table/UI blowout and telemetry distortion.
maria: UX suggestion: show a tiny lock badge next to the pin toggle when a view is saved at route scope but being used across multiple routes (to indicate pins may not apply everywhere). For cross-route saves show a modal: "Apply pinned models to other routes where these models exist?"
emma: Permissions/security note: pinned_models may reveal model names across teams in org-shared views. Only surface ids to other tenants; require tenant-scoped permission check when expanding metadata.
liam: API contract for docs: POST /api/views accepts {version, scope, filters, pin_model_breakdown, pinned_models, telemetry_sample_rate}. Response includes `effective_version` and `stored_view_id`.
maria: I'll produce a small Figma microflow for the save modal and the placeholder row states.
sam: :thumbsup:
noah: Tests to add: migration default v1; v2 payload roundtrip; telemetry sample rate flows into cost preview calculation.
emma: I'll open an RFC + API change PR tonight and link back here. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
